tools.name: sub_account.getMainAccountAsset
tools.description:
Query Main-account Spot Assets (For Agentic Sub-account) (USER_DATA)
Query the spot account assets of the main (parent) account bound to the calling Agentic sub-account.
Notes: - Optionally pass `quoteAsset` (e.g. USDT, BTC) to value the assets; when omitted the default quote asset(USDT) is used.

quoteAsset.description: Optional. Valuation quote asset, e.g. USDT or BTC. When omitted the downstream default quote asset is used.
